instruction:
Primary Frame Structural IFC

This task starts from scratch with no init_file inputs and no local reference images. Create a metric IFC4 primary structural frame and save the required output as /home/user/Desktop/result.ifc.

## Pass conditions
1. The output folder contains /home/user/Desktop/result.ifc, and /home/user/Desktop/result.ifc is at least 500 bytes.
2. /home/user/Desktop/result.ifc uses an IFC4 schema.
3. The IFC model contains exactly 1 IfcProject, 1 IfcSite, 1 IfcBuilding, 1 IfcBuildingStorey, 4 IfcColumn entities, 4 IfcBeam entities, 1 IfcSlab, 1 IfcStructuralAnalysisModel, and 1 IfcRelAssignsToGroup relationship.
4. The IFC model contains 0 IfcSpace, 0 IfcWall, 0 IfcDoor, 0 IfcWindow, 0 IfcBuildingElementProxy, 0 IfcFurniture, 0 IfcRoof, 0 IfcStair, and 0 IfcFlowTerminal entities.
5. All IfcRoot GlobalId values are unique.
6. The single IfcBuildingStorey is named exactly Level 00, ignoring leading and trailing whitespace only.
7. The IfcStructuralAnalysisModel is named exactly Primary Frame, ignoring leading and trailing whitespace only, and its single IfcRelAssignsToGroup relationship assigns exactly these 8 named frame members: C1, C2, C3, C4, B1, B2, B3, and B4.
8. The IfcColumn names are exactly C1, C2, C3, and C4, ignoring leading and trailing whitespace only; each column has bounding-box dimensions 0.30 m by 0.30 m by 3.60 m, in any axis order, with tolerance +/-0.08 m.
9. The column center XY coordinates match C1 at 0.00 m, 0.00 m; C2 at 6.00 m, 0.00 m; C3 at 6.00 m, 4.00 m; and C4 at 0.00 m, 4.00 m, each coordinate with tolerance +/-0.12 m.
10. The IfcBeam names are exactly B1, B2, B3, and B4, ignoring leading and trailing whitespace only; B1 and B2 each have bounding-box dimensions 6.00 m by 0.30 m by 0.45 m, and B3 and B4 each have bounding-box dimensions 0.30 m by 4.00 m by 0.45 m, each in any axis order with tolerance +/-0.08 m.
11. The slab is named exactly Deck Slab, ignoring leading and trailing whitespace only, and has bounding-box dimensions 6.00 m by 4.00 m by 0.18 m, in any axis order, with tolerance +/-0.08 m.
12. All columns, beams, and the slab are spatially assigned to Level 00.

Any item not explicitly required in the pass conditions may vary.
